text:
Riley (People Ops): Quick pulse  planning a small hybrid pickup & mini-ceremony for the Spring Spot Awards. Need to confirm pickup windows, micro-ceremony slots, and alternative gift options for internationals. Thoughts?
Samir: Love it. For pickup windows can we do 3 blocks (9-11, 12-2, 4-6) over two days? Keeps lines short.
Dina: Works for SF office. Can Events reserve the foyer and a table? Wefll need a card table and two volunteers per shift.
Nate (Events): Yes, reserving foyer. Volunteers ok. I'll book 3 x 2hr slots both days and post a volunteer signup.
Riley (People Ops): Awesome. Volunteers: please use #volunteer-signup when you claim a slot so we can track headcount.
Samir: Question on gifts: some nominees are remote in APAC & EU. Options we proposed were pin, donation, or digital gift card. Are digital cards ok?
Carlos (Finance): Digital gift cards are fine but they count toward the award budget the same as physical. If you choose physical for APAC we need customs approval.
Dina: Could we offer a custom digital badge (for internal profiles) as an extra low-cost option?
Riley (People Ops): Love the digital badge idea. We'll add a "profile_badge" option in the sheet.
MerchBot: [system] Current inventory: pins=120, enamel_mugs=40, physical_cards=90. Lead time for new pins: 12 business days.
Samir: If lead time is 12 days, we need to lock final gifts by EOD Fri.
Riley (People Ops): Agreed. Deadline: end of day Fri. I'll send a reminder to managers.
Nate (Events): For the mini-ceremony, propose 5-minute spotlight per winner, 2 winners per timeslot, with a short trophy photo. AV: one mic & a phone tripod for livestream.
Dina: Photo ops sound great. Can we do a shared Drive folder for photos?
Nate (Events): I'll create it and post link in the sheet.
Carlos (Finance): Tax note: if a nominee receives >$600 in gift value and is US-taxable, we need to collect a W-9. We'll coordinate via payroll.
Riley (People Ops): Good call. We'll add a column "tax_notice_needed" that Finance will populate after review. Managers, please do not ask nominees about tax forms directly. We'll handle outreach.
Samir: Logistics Q: can managers pick up on behalf of nominees? Some people are fully remote.
Riley (People Ops): Yes, but please mark "proxy_pickup_by=[name]" in the sheet and include recipient's preferred email for digital items.
MerchBot: [system] Shipping cost estimates: domestic=$6, EU=$14, APAC=$22. Physical gifting outside US will trigger a customs review.
Dina: For budget predictability, can we cap year-print mugs to 50? We don't need year prints for everyone.
Carlos (Finance): Cap at 50 year-print mugs without additional approval. Anything beyond requires manager-level justification and a finance signoff.
Riley (People Ops): Final checklist I'll send: 1) Manager finalizations in sheet by EOD Fri; 2) Volunteers in #volunteer-signup; 3) Events will publish Drive + schedule; 4) Finance will mark tax notices by next Tue; 5) Merch orders locked after finance signoff.
Samir: Thanks Riley. Ifll ping my managers now.
Riley (People Ops): Thanks y'all  will post reminder and finalize schedule on Monday. :sparkles:
